description: This file defines the AnalysisRepository class that provides CRUD operations for the 'analyses' database table within the application. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and listing analysis records, utilizing async database operations.

classes.name: AnalysisRepository
classes.description: Repository class for performing database operations related to analyses, inheriting base CRUD functionality from BaseRepository.

methods.name: UUID create( self, user_id: UUID, resume_id: Optional[int], profile_id: Optional[int], target_role: Optional[str], status: str, score_overall: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a new analysis record into the database and returns its UUID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get(self, analysis_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves an analysis record by its UUID, returning it as a dictionary.

methods.name: None update_status(self, analysis_id: UUID, status: str, score_overall: Optional[float] = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and optionally the overall score of a specific analysis record.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_user(self, user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches all analysis records associated with a given user, ordered by creation date.
